name: Maria Rodriguez
summary: High-achieving 35-year-old sales professional in Los Angeles driven by career advancement and recognition. Collaborative team player who values efficiency, customer relationships, and peer support. Embraces tools that improve productivity but resists changes that disrupt established workflows.
quote: Every minute I spend fighting with our systems is a minute I'm not spending with customers. I've figured out workarounds, but I shouldn't have to.

demographics.background: 8 years of sales experience with consistent high performance. Active mentor to new hires and advocate for diversity and inclusion initiatives.

needs.need: Achieve recognition for high performance and contributions
Grow professionally and advance to leadership roles
Build meaningful relationships and help others succeed
Have autonomy in how she approaches her work

frustrations.frustration: Impatience with inefficient processes that waste time
Frustration when lack of information affects her ability to perform
Resistance to changes that disrupt established, successful workflows

technology.description: Highly proficient with CRM systems and mobile tools. Quick to adopt new technology that saves time. Uses mobile devices extensively while travelling. Comfortable with digital collaboration tools.
